role_label: Reference proteome & identical-sequence protein-equivalence groups (PEG)
label: Human Ensembl 115 GRCh38 + MANE Select
threshold_or_use: Prefer MANE Select then Ensembl canonical; collapse identical translations into PEG; >=95% 9-mer Unsafe containment -> Other:Sequence
limitations: Representative-protein equivalence does not assert equal abundance of alternative isoforms.

role_label: Healthy non-thymic, non-reproductive baseline (N) & Disposable maximum (D)
label: GTEx v11, HPA v23 tissues/brain & HPA/DICE/Monaco immune
threshold_or_use: Within-site linear donor P95 sets non-thymic somatic N and Disposable D (<=32 TPM); H0 = max(N, D, 1 TPM)
limitations: 56 required healthy contexts; bulk thymus stays in thymic scope outside N and D.

role_label: Normal somatic bulk & sorted immune RNA safety ceilings
label: HPA v23 consensus/brain/immune, GTEx v11 medians & DICE/Monaco
threshold_or_use: Base ceilings Vital <=4, Protected <=8, Manageable <=16 (Unsafe >128) in native unit; matched negative IHC raises ceiling 2x/4x/8x
limitations: TPM and nTPM run separate native gates without cross-unit conversion.

role_label: Single-cell cluster & donor-resolved rare-cell UMI safety screens
label: CELLxGENE Census, Siletti brain, HPA v23 scRNA clusters & Collin cornea
threshold_or_use: UMI: >=10 cells and >=1% >=2-UMI cells across >=2 consortium-deduplicated study groups (or >=5% in 1 study; 2x in Protected); cornea CP10K /100 nominal ceiling
limitations: Paralog/3'-host mapping ambiguity without bulk or qPCR confirmation stays Other:Review.

role_label: Normal-tissue protein staining (IHC) or mass-spectrometry proteomics
label: HPA v23 normal immunohistochemistry & curated external staining
threshold_or_use: Approved/Supported/Enhanced positive staining in Vital/Protected tissues -> Unsafe; routine-context negative IHC grants RNA headroom
limitations: Antibody reliability is categorical support, not a calibrated false-negative rate.

role_label: Adult reproductive & embryonic/placental enrichment (RA) and host exposure
label: GTEx/HPA adult reproductive samples & Petropoulos/Tyser/Molè embryos
threshold_or_use: RA qualifies at >=10 x H0 in adult reproductive samples or cell-supported embryo lineages; per-compartment maxima feed HostContext (<8 TPM / <8 nTPM, 2x with negative IHC)
limitations: Early embryo atlases do not cover mid/late fetal stages; pregnancy protection remains conservative.

role_label: QC-passing tumor cohorts for cancer enrichment (CA)
label: 135 QC-passing per-sample in-vivo human tumor cohorts (TCGA, TARGET, BEAT-AML, Treehouse, GEO)
threshold_or_use: CA qualifies when >=1 QC-passing in-vivo tumor library reaches >=10 x H0; tags ectopic vs lineage_retained activation
limitations: Cross-study cohorts use library gDNA QC and nonnegative linear TPM checks rather than batch correction.

role_label: Curated normal counterevidence, unscreened adult homes & published nominations
label: Reviewed normal-tissue literature, #711 Ensembl 115 attribution ledger & 149 CTA/oncofetal papers
threshold_or_use: Verified adult Vital/Protected expression -> Unsafe; unscreened adult home (olfactory/chemosensory GPCRs, taste bud, bone, dental pulp, hair follicle) -> Other:Unscreened tissue
limitations: Published CTA nominations are provenance only and never override normal-tissue counterevidence.

role_label: Reference proteome & identical-sequence protein-equivalence groups (PEG)
label: Canine Ensembl 98 CanFam3.1 (GCA_000002285.2, primary) & NCBI RefSeq 106 (UU_Cfam_GSD_1.0)
threshold_or_use: Complete GTF/cDNA/ncRNA/peptide FASTA pins; identical translations collapse into canine PEG:<sha256>; >=95% canine 9-mer Unsafe containment
limitations: CanFam3.1 is a female Boxer assembly; unplaced scaffolds are retained and Y-linked single-copy loci remain unrepresented.

role_label: Healthy non-thymic, non-reproductive baseline (N) & Disposable maximum (D)
label: Bgee 15.2 adult canine multi-organ RNA-seq, GSE219045 300-sample organ atlas & healthy companion-dog adrenal/blood/marrow/gingiva/brain/liver/lung/spleen controls
threshold_or_use: Within-organ donor P95 across 24 required (36 evaluated) non-thymic adult somatic contexts sets N and canine Disposable D (gallbladder, tonsil, hair follicle); <=2.5% ectopic OR gDNA QC
limitations: Unvalidated monogenic chemosensory GPCRs, dental-pulp and taste-bud home loci remain Other:Unscreened tissue.

role_label: Normal somatic bulk & sorted immune RNA safety ceilings
label: Bgee 15.2 adult canine somatic/leukocyte RNA, GSE219045 whole-blood/marrow/lymph-node atlas & GSE283373 primary canine alveolar macrophages
threshold_or_use: Tiered somatic & macrophage ceilings Vital <=4, Protected <=8, Manageable <=16 (Unsafe >128) TPM without negative-IHC multipliers
limitations: Sorted activated canine T/NK cytokine subsets remain narrower than human DICE/Monaco and murine ImmGen.

role_label: Single-cell cluster & donor-resolved rare-cell UMI safety screens
label: GSE225599 healthy companion-dog circulating leukocyte 10x single-cell UMI atlas (7 healthy donors H_1..H_7)
threshold_or_use: Evaluates donor-resolved circulating T/NK lymphocytes, monocytes, neutrophils (Protected) and platelets (Vital) on native CanFam3.1 ENSCAFG IDs via assess_rare_cell_rna
limitations: Covers circulating hematopoietic & platelet populations; solid-organ adult canine normal scRNA atlases remain future additions.

role_label: Normal-tissue protein staining (IHC) or mass-spectrometry proteomics
label: Pfizer 38-tissue canine quantitative proteomics (MSV000099744, 9,929 protein groups)
threshold_or_use: Sequence-reconciled Vital (>25 ppm Unsafe, 10-25 ppm hold) & Protected (>50 ppm Unsafe, 20-50 ppm hold) tissue-pool protein gates after 10% same-plex reproductive TMT bleed subtraction; never grants negative-IHC RNA multipliers
limitations: All 38 tissue samples are pooled TMT channels without individual-donor counts or cell-type resolution.

role_label: Adult reproductive & embryonic/placental enrichment (RA) and host exposure
label: Bgee 15.2 testis/ovary/placenta/d33-d44 embryos, GSE219045 male/female reproductive tract, GSE119810 normal resting/lactating mammary & Pfizer Fallopian_Tube/Endometrium proteomics
threshold_or_use: RA qualifies at >=10 x H0 across canine compartments (uterine_horn, absent seminal vesicle, milk-operon secretory separation) and populates canine HostContext
limitations: Canine fallopian tube lacks a public RNA-seq atlas and is screened via Pfizer quantitative proteomics (coverage='proteome_only').

role_label: QC-passing tumor cohorts for cancer enrichment (CA)
label: 19 spontaneous companion-dog patient tumor cohorts across 13 histologies (OSA, CMT, HSA, LYM, GLIOMA, URO, STS, COSCC, CAA, HS, MNG, ACC, THCA, LEUK) + 12 canine cancer cell lines (CLBL-1, 8 MGT, 3 HS)
threshold_or_use: CA qualifies strictly in >=1 QC-passing (<=2.5% OR gDNA) spontaneous in-vivo patient tumor at >=10 x H0; cell lines populate cell_line_* model-selection reference only
limitations: Spontaneous oral melanoma linear-TPM patient cohorts remain a priority future histology.

role_label: Curated normal counterevidence, unscreened adult homes & published nominations
label: Curated canine CTA nominations (14 candidates), somatic RT-qPCR holds & essential canine activated-TIL checkpoint/cytokine exclusions
threshold_or_use: Reconciles all 14 published canine nominations onto CanFam3.1, holds somatic RT-PCR positives, excludes essential TIL checkpoints/cytokines, and enforces zero cross-species CTA transfer
limitations: Human CTA labels are never transferred to canine orthologs.

role_label: Reference proteome & identical-sequence protein-equivalence groups (PEG)
label: Mouse Ensembl 115 GRCm39 (GCA_000001635.9, C57BL/6J, 66,668 proteins)
threshold_or_use: Complete GTF/cDNA/ncRNA/peptide FASTA pins; identical translations collapse into murine PEG:<sha256>; >=95% murine 9-mer Unsafe containment
limitations: Reference coordinates are C57BL/6J; DBA/2, BALB/c and FVB polymorphisms require explicit sequence verification.

role_label: Healthy non-thymic, non-reproductive baseline (N) & Disposable maximum (D)
label: Bgee 15.2 adult murine multi-organ RNA-seq (12 experiments), GSE219045 sex-stratified preclinical organ atlas & GSE322844 WT liver
threshold_or_use: Within-organ donor P95 across 30 non-thymic adult somatic contexts sets N; H0 = max(N, D, 1 TPM); thymus stays in thymic scope
limitations: Unvalidated monogenic chemosensory GPCRs, hair-follicle, dental-pulp and taste-bud home loci remain Other:Unscreened tissue.

role_label: Normal somatic bulk & sorted immune RNA safety ceilings
source_id: bgee_v15_2_mouse_somatic + gse219045 + immgen_gse109125_gse122108 + gse181223_bmdm + gse287306_gse336796_gse302070_nk_treg + sarma1999
label: Bgee 15.2 somatic RNA, GSE219045 organ atlas, ImmGen sorted/activated immune, LPS BMDMs, splenic/IL-15/IL-2/ionomycin NK & Treg panels & LAK granzyme/Sarma 1999 gates
threshold_or_use: Quantitative somatic & sorted/activated immune panels apply Vital <=4, Protected <=8, Manageable <=16 (Unsafe >128) TPM without negative-IHC multipliers; excludes LAK cytolytic granzymes Gzmd/e/f/g and holds Trap1a
limitations: Sorted ULI FACS populations require >=2-replicate support (min(P95, second_highest)) to reject single-tube carryover.

role_label: Single-cell cluster & donor-resolved rare-cell UMI safety screens
label: Tabula Muris 10x droplet single-cell UMI atlas across 10 adult Vital/Protected somatic organs
threshold_or_use: Enters assess_rare_cell_rna (>=10 cells, >=5% single-study or bulk/GXD-confirmed >=1% >=2-UMI in Vital, 2x in Protected) with Ensembl 115 31-mer/host mapping-risk flags
limitations: Single-study 10x UMI signals between 1% and 5% without bulk or GXD confirmation await a second independent murine UMI atlas.

role_label: Normal-tissue protein staining (IHC) or mass-spectrometry proteomics
label: MGI Gene Expression Database (GXD 6.27) TS28 adult Immunohistochemistry (MMO:0000498) & Immunoblot (MMO:0000672)
threshold_or_use: >=2 independent publications in Vital/Protected adult somatic organs -> Unsafe; 1 publication -> Other:Review hold; never grants negative-IHC RNA ceiling multipliers
limitations: Literature-curated assays cover studied proteins unevenly; unassayed organs never imply protein absence.

role_label: Adult reproductive & embryonic/placental enrichment (RA) and host exposure
label: Bgee 15.2 & GSE219045 gonads/placenta/embryo plus WT anterior prostate (coagulating_gland), ventral prostate, seminal vesicle, oviduct, uterine horn, endometrium, cervix, vagina & lactating mammary
threshold_or_use: RA qualifies at >=10 x H0 across all 16 murine compartments (including coagulating_gland, seminal vesicle, uterine_horn, lactating_mammary) and populates 16-organ HostContext
limitations: Embryo libraries remain bulk/tissue developmental stages (scope_complete=False under pregnancy protection).

role_label: QC-passing tumor cohorts for cancer enrichment (CA)
label: 14 strain-explicit in-vivo murine tumor cohorts (MC38, CT26, B16F10, B78_MEL, LLC, EMT6, RM1, GL261_TUMOR, CT2A_TUMOR, SB28_TUMOR, MADR_GLIOMA, KP_LUAD, BMPC_PRAD, DEN_HCC) + 9 pure cancer cell lines (4T1, P815, EO771, Hepa1-6, ID8, GL261_LINE, MB49, MOC1, MOC22)
threshold_or_use: CA qualifies strictly in >=1 QC-passing in-vivo tumor sample at >=10 x H0 on Ensembl 115 TPM; pure cell lines populate cell_line_* purity/model-selection reference only
limitations: Covers 14 widely used syngeneic, orthotopic, primary GEMM, and carcinogen-induced models across C57BL/6, BALB/c, and FVB.

role_label: Curated normal counterevidence, unscreened adult homes & published nominations
label: Van den Eynde 1991 (P1A DBA/2 P815 clone 211), Sarma 1999 normal-tissue follow-up & IL-2/IL-12/IL-18 LAK granzyme counterevidence
threshold_or_use: Preserves exact 224-aa AAA40475.1 / ENSMUSP00000059448.4 protein equivalence alongside BALB/c somatic counterevidence and host TIL granzyme exclusions
limitations: Transgenic tolerance experiments are excluded from endogenous normal-expression claims.
